source_authorization: Narrow operation capability explicitly created by normative design; never inferred from current role privileges. No grants performed. Backend catalog access implementation must prove this source scope, not just label itself INVOKER.
credential_rule: Only S01/S02/S04/S05 consume the private Reader bound-session descriptor. No copying to pure transform/evaluator. S03 uses its existing independent self-session authenticated context. No shared generic credential. Revoke/expiry/generation mismatch aborts all in-flight publication.
search_path_control: No search_path-based resolution, user-provided type/operator identifiers, temporary objects or replaceable callback dispatch
owner_control: Deployment-only install/replace; implementation owner cannot confer runtime source authority through membership or SD. Reader cannot own/replace objects; future ACL audit mandatory.
